title: Connecting TRAINEX Hardware
summary: Overview of how an ESP32 controller can forward normalized commands to an active TRAINEX browser session.
prerequisites: Deployed TRAINEX website with a compatible secure relay
Network connection and matching pairing/session identifiers

steps.title: Power the controller
steps.body: Use a suitable USB supply and confirm the ESP32 firmware is running.

steps.title: Connect through the relay
steps.body: Pair the hardware session through the website’s hardware interface. For a deployed HTTPS site, use a secure wss:// relay.

steps.title: Verify pairing
steps.body: Check that device and session identifiers match. Do not send hardware commands to an unpaired session.

steps.title: Test a safe control
steps.body: At standstill, move the controller to N or operate a non-traction training control and confirm the same state appears in 2D and 3D.

steps.title: Disconnect safely
steps.body: End the pairing and stop the active session after training.

notes: Bluetooth is not required for the Wi-Fi/WebSocket workflow.
The browser cannot connect directly to arbitrary ESP32 devices across the public internet without a reachable relay.
The relay/firmware must implement the agreed command protocol; educational content does not install those services.
